title: Maldon East
description: Maldon, Essex — historic market town on the Blackwater Estuary. Home to the Battle of Maldon (991 AD) and the eastern terminus of the GER Maldon branch line (1848–1964). 2 km × 2 km world at 2 m terrain resolution. Features: Maldon East station site, Hythe Quay, River Blackwater, and the trackbed of the former branch line.
roads: OSM: A414 primary, B1018, residential, service
features: Environment Agency LiDAR 2 m terrain, Blackwater estuary, OSM game elements (medians, barriers, sidewalks), historical railway trackbed
